name: IDB isolation + sender.url check (#196)
description: Reproducer for spec 2026-06-11-position-store-service-worker §Empirical Precondition. Verifies (1) a content script cannot open the extension-origin IndexedDB 'speedreader-positions' (oldVersion===0), with the popup inverse RPC confirming the shared chrome-extension://<id> namespace; (2) sender.url is populated for a CS->SW message without the tabs permission and equals the top-frame page URL, with the about:blank opaque-origin path hard-rejected; (3) (manual) chrome.storage.session does not survive a real browser restart.
